column1: # Words other than prepositions (those are "govern" in words.tsv) that govern a number right after them: verbs,
# nouns and adjectives. Tab-separated: the kind, the cases (letters N G D A I P, the most likely first; "-" for
# not_verb) and the forms, comma-separated, "ё" and "е" alike.
#   verb         a verb whose number is not in the accusative: "достигает 100 Мбит/с" -> "достигает ст+а"
#   noun         a noun whose number is in the genitive: "строительство 1200 квартир" -> "т+ысячи двухс+от квартир"
#   verb_ending  the end of a masculine past, an infinitive, an imperative "-авь": a number right after it is in the
#                accusative, "принял 21 пациента" -> "дв+адцать одног+о"; not "куплена 1 лампа", "стоит 1 машина"
#   not_verb     a word with such an end that is not a verb: "бюджет"; forms of "быть" have no object
